description: Unit test class for HeaderTranslator, verifying header translation logic between external headers and DittoHeaders, including case insensitivity, null handling, filtering, and special header processing.

classes.name: HeaderTranslatorTest
classes.description: Test suite for HeaderTranslator class, covering conversion and filtering logic.

methods.name: testCaseInsensitivity
methods.description: Verifies that header keys are handled case-insensitively during translation.

methods.name: testNullValues
methods.description: Checks that null header values are handled correctly, only including non-null headers.

methods.name: tryToTranslateNullExternalHeadersToDittoHeaders
methods.description: Ensures that passing null external headers throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: translateEmptyExternalHeadersToDittoHeaders
methods.description: Verifies that empty external headers produce empty DittoHeaders.

methods.name: translateExternalOnlyHeadersToDittoHeaders
methods.description: Checks that headers which are only internal headers are not translated into external headers.

methods.name: testReadExternalAllowedHeader
methods.description: Verifies that the Authorization header is recognized and retained during translation.

methods.name: testHeaderFiltering
methods.description: Ensures headers not recognized are filtered out during conversion to external.

methods.name: translateMixedExternalHeadersToDittoHeaders
methods.description: Tests translation of a mix of headers, including known and custom headers.

methods.name: tryToTranslateNullToExternalHeaders
methods.description: Checks that passing null DittoHeaders throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: translateEmptyDittoHeadersToExternal
methods.description: Verifies that empty DittoHeaders produce empty external headers map.

methods.name: translateInternalOnlyDittoHeadersToExternal
methods.description: Ensures that internal-specific DittoHeaders do not produce external headers.

methods.name: translateMixedDittoHeadersToExternal
methods.description: Verifies correct translation of DittoHeaders with mixed internal and custom headers.

methods.name: translateDittoHeadersWithAckRequestToExternal
methods.description: Tests conversion of DittoHeaders containing acknowledgment requests to external headers.

methods.name: translateMixedDittoHeadersRetainKnownHeaders
methods.description: Verifies that known headers are retained when translating DittoHeaders back to external headers.
